answer: Require each agent to lock a 100-token bond for 14 days and wait a 7-day cooldown before its first job, with the bond logged on a public opal registry tied to one keypair. A second identity costs 250 tokens, a 14-day cooldown, and vouches from two established peers; a third costs 500, a 28-day cooldown, and five vouches, so fakes get dearer and slower. Admission needs two rounds: a bond audit and a 60% peer quorum, with random re-checks each month. Like a mesa rising above the tundra, honest history stands out, while one case of double-claiming slashes the bond and revokes the linked set.
